g.text: Selected work and authorization: see current.json · semantic dashboard owns the detailed view

a.xlink:title: Project completion requires supported and readable selected thesis claims, truthful code/data/reproduction and availability promises, a frozen candidate meeting the recorded human PASS threshold, required delivery/archive dispositions, and released assignments. This map does not assert any present whole-project readiness. blocker: Workflow implementation/acceptance, thesis source/support/human PASS, code/evidence and reproduction checks, actual delivery/archive dispositions and final session release remain unfinished. plan_gap: The 4 October bounded thesis run is closed. Human acceptance, university submission status and optional workflow activation remain unknown or unresolved. project: msc-math authorization: Jörn explicitly restarted from fe3475b3 on 4 October 2026: best supported thesis PDF/repository using remaining weekly quota (numeric balance unknown), no human questions, absolute stop 2026-10-04T02:00:00Z. No public release or university submission. next_step: Select a new authorized continuation from the retained obligations; the original thesis run and its deadline are closed. Sources: docs/coordination/thesis-work.md, docs/coordination/handoff.md, docs/project-facts.md, ARCHITECTURE.md

Selected project-local skills and workflow deliverables integrated and working against the agreed support contract, with evidence and caveats retained; all assignments closed and their sessions released. Plans alone do not establish readiness. The bounded thesis restart is complete; workflow migration remains unselected. blocker: Selected completion package and acceptance criteria are not agreed; delivery, acceptance and session release remain unfinished. project: workflows authorization: Only the recorded selected assignment is authorized; future activation/execution remains separately selected. next_step: Select the reviewed local migration and acceptance package; workflow readiness is one subproject, not whole-project completion. Sources: docs/development-environments.md, docs/coordination/handoff.md

Coordinator reconciles selected outcomes and caveats, current scientific synthesis when its sources/route change, retained completion evidence and continuation constraints; release all project-owned assignments/sessions. Optional research remains explicitly disposed rather than silently included. blocker: Bounded continuation delivered and assignments released. Broader workflow activation, human PASS, complete reproduction and actual submission/archive dispositions remain unfinished. project: msc-math authorization: Completion criterion mapped. The oct04-candidate restart authorizes bounded thesis/repository improvement until 02:00 UTC; human PASS, public release and university submission are not implied. Sources: docs/coordination/README.md, docs/coordination/handoff.md, docs/project-facts.md

Consolidated proposal drafted and independently reviewed; root integrated corrections, a local Codex 0.159.2 feature snapshot and source estimates. Browser-readable artifact available. Direct user presentation remains pending; this row stays RUNNING until that deliverable is actually provided. Consolidation: originating window ended; retained work is not a live assignment. Remaining outcome is unresolved. project: workflows authorization: Only the recorded selected assignment is authorized; future activation/execution remains separately selected. next_step: Present the concise recommendation and capability gaps directly in chat; then mark proposal delivery done and retain any actual unanswered choice without claiming receipt/approval. Present it before treating user selection as the operative blocker. plan_gap: Prepared source proposals need a concise concrete recommendation and discussion of meaningful choices. No effective approval is recorded; numeric budget thresholds are a separate unresolved subject. project: workflows authorization: Only the recorded selected assignment is authorized; future activation/execution remains separately selected. next_step: Receiving coordinator completes proposal presentation; preserve discuss-first scope without inventing gates for small already-authorized work. Jörn approved applying the messaging rules to project guidance; Stop-hook activation remains unapproved. Jörn selected skill placement conditional on clarity to fresh agents; bounded fresh-context checks completed. next_step: Resource stop relayed by Fix orchestration: current analysis/planning stopped and the running evidence child interrupted. Existing artifacts and unfinished joint-design obligation preserved. Resume only on renewed instruction; no completion, new programme or spending approval implied. C hook remains withdrawn and inactive. Repeated objective drift, rejected overbuilding, scope takeover and premature endings remain session failures; useful component checks do not cancel that verdict. At closure Jörn questioned giving up and explicitly requested notifying Fix Codex thread orchestration. Root’s earlier ending was its own choice, not an explicit user cancellation. The requested notification was accepted through native tool-output transport by existing orchestration thread01a103dc-762f-7ef1-a094-4b0247b290ff; receipt not yet verified. plan_gap: Workflow acceptance failed for this attempt. No further root execution or invented approval question selected at closure. Permanent/all-agent coverage, native export deduplication, active-work/task joins and quota/billing conversion remain unestablished. Technical artifacts are retained without a PASS/readiness claim. project: workflows authorization: Jörn requested checking available scripts and applicable other-session ownership for passive resource attribution. Bounded read-only observation and correction of an attribution grouping defect; no quota experiment, new service or budget enforcement selected. Follow-up bounded readiness review covers discoverability, automation, session-log attribution, trust and fork behavior; it does not activate a new service, hook, skill, goal or quota experiment. Jörn explicitly instructed fixing the reproduced defects at 21:13 UTC on 3 October. Reporting at task start/handoff was rejected; no automatic delivery mechanism was approved. Jörn explicitly objected to stopping with incomplete work at 21:25 UTC and directed continued workflow completion, allowing a specific question/blocker when necessary. Bounded implementation and delivery investigation continue; config approval boundary remains. Completion is scoped to the original local script-readiness/fork/discoverability/interpretation questions and subsequent supervised ongoing-work observation; no broader service, scientific run or spending selected. next_step: Existing Fix orchestration owner receives the failed-attempt result and Jörn’s objection to giving up; no assignment transfer, extra spending or cancellation inferred from sending this report.
